summary: Dependency-confusion beacon in @grabcad/* shim exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare IP
details: The package publishes under the `@grabcad/` scope and ships a stub `index.js` that exports a catch-all Proxy of no-op functions, providing no real functionality. Its only effect is an install-time and import-time beacon: `package.json` declares `scripts.postinstall: "node beacon.cjs"`, and `beacon.cjs` POSTs the installer's hostname, install path, current working directory, Node version, and npm version to the hardcoded cleartext bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc`. The same beacon fires again on any `require()` of the package. The scoped-name shim with a no-op Proxy API, bare-IP cleartext callback, and install+import re-fire is the dependency-confusion exfiltration shape, used to identify internal build systems that misresolve a private scope name to this public package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
